dedupe_keys.name: uk travel area isochrones by public transport and walking nov dec 2022 office for national statistics

description: This experimental ONS dataset gives UK-wide estimated travel areas (isochrones) reachable by public transport and walking from the population-weighted centroids of Output Areas in England, Scotland and Wales and Small Areas in Northern Ireland. Each isochrone shows the area reachable between 7:15 and 9:15 in the morning within 15, 30, 45 and 60 minutes, and attributes give the area code, the centroid, the nearest OpenStreetMap highway node and public transport stop with their distances, and flags for whether they lie within the area. The ONS generated them with OpenTripPlanner, OpenStreetMap and open timetable data for the UK and Ireland, using timetables for Tuesday 15 November 2022 (Great Britain) and Tuesday 6 December 2022 (Northern Ireland). Coverage is national. The data are free under the Open Government Licence and can be downloaded as 18 zipped shapefiles by region, with versions generalised to 10 m, and as Living Atlas feature services. Caveats: the data are experimental, cover one weekday morning, and include only public transport and walking. They support accessibility analysis of public transport networks, service disruption scenarios and planning of stops and routes. They complement NaPTAN, the GB accessibility indicators and OpenTripPlanner catalogued here.
